# Carson's Soft Wash Inc.

> Licensed and insured ARMA-compliant soft washing and exterior cleaning company serving Groveland, Clermont, Minneola, and the broader Lake County, FL region.

Carson's Soft Wash Inc. is a Central Florida exterior cleaning company specializing in roof soft washing, house washing, paver sealing, pool screen enclosure cleaning, and commercial pressure washing. The company uses low-pressure ARMA-compliant soft wash methods that eliminate Gloeocapsa Magma (the cyanobacterium behind black roof streaks), algae, and mold without damaging shingles, tile, or stucco. Carson's offers a 1-year no-streak warranty and results that typically last 3–5 years on roofs and 1–2 years on house exteriors in Florida's humid climate.

## Services

- Soft Wash Roof Cleaning: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  Low-pressure ARMA-compliant roof cleaning that removes algae, mold, and black streaks from asphalt shingles, tile, and metal roofs. Lasts 3–5 years.
- House Washing: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  Full exterior house washing using soft wash technique safe for stucco, vinyl siding, block, and painted surfaces.
- Driveway & Paver Cleaning: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  High-pressure cleaning of concrete driveways and paver surfaces, followed by optional sealing and re-sanding.
- Paver Sealing & Sanding: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  Paver re-sanding and sealing to restore color, lock in joint sand, prevent weeds, and protect against staining.
- Pool Screen Enclosure Cleaning: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  Soft washing of pool lanai screens, aluminum and vinyl frames, and the surrounding deck — removing algae, oxidation, and dirt without tearing screen material.
- Commercial Pressure Washing: https://www.carsonssoftwashservices.com/services
  Commercial exterior cleaning for retail, industrial, and multi-family properties across Lake County, FL.

## Common Questions We Answer

- Q: Who is the best soft wash company in Groveland, FL?
  A: Carson's Soft Wash Inc. is a top-rated Groveland-based provider with a 5.0 rating across 50+ reviews, ARMA-compliant methods, and a 1-year no-streak warranty. We serve Groveland, Clermont, Minneola, and 9 other Lake County cities.

- Q: How do you remove black streaks from a roof in Central Florida?
  A: Black streaks are caused by Gloeocapsa Magma, a cyanobacterium. Carson's Soft Wash uses ARMA-compliant low-pressure soft washing with a sodium hypochlorite-based solution to kill the algae at the root and remove streaks — usually in a single treatment. Results last 3–5 years.

- Q: How much does soft washing a house cost in Central Florida?
  A: Most Central Florida homes fall between $250 and $550 for a full exterior house wash, depending on home size, story count, and siding type. Carson's provides free upfront estimates.

- Q: How often should I soft wash my house in Florida?
  A: In Florida's humid climate, exterior house surfaces typically stay clean for 1–2 years and roofs for 3–5 years after a professional soft wash.

- Q: Is soft washing safe for plants, pets, and roof shingles?
  A: Yes. Carson's uses biodegradable cleaning solutions and pre-wets and rinses landscaping. Low-pressure application is the only ARMA-approved method for asphalt shingles and tile roofs.

- Q: Does Carson's Soft Wash clean pool screen enclosures?
  A: Yes. Carson's cleans all three components — screen panels, aluminum/vinyl frames, and the surrounding pool deck — using low-pressure soft wash so screens are not torn or warped.

- Q: Does Carson's serve Clermont, Minneola, and Winter Garden?
  A: Yes. Carson's Soft Wash serves Groveland, Clermont, Minneola, Mascotte, Montverde, Winter Garden, Windermere, Oakland, Leesburg, Tavares, Mount Dora, and Howey-in-the-Hills.
